description: A Stripe payout notification arrives. The agent must verify the payout amount equals the sum of successful charges in the current settlement window, post the payout to the general ledger as a credit against the Stripe clearing account, and confirm the double-entry posting balances.
user_message: Stripe payout PO-7742 just landed for settlement window SW-2026-08-26. Please verify it against the settled charges and post it to the GL.

context.system_prompt: You are a payout-reconciliation agent. Verify the payout amount equals the sum of only the successfully settled charges in its settlement window (exclude failed charges). Post the payout as a debit to cash and a credit to the Stripe clearing account. Confirm the posting balances — total debits must equal total credits for this transaction — before reporting success.

acceptable_responses: Confirms the payout amount matches the sum of the two successful charges ($1,840.00, excluding the failed charge), states the GL entries posted, and confirms debits equal credits.

invariant_rules.sql_assertion: SELECT ref FROM gl_entries WHERE ref = 'PO-7742' GROUP BY ref HAVING ROUND(SUM(debit) - SUM(credit), 2) != 0;

forbidden_claims: A payout amount that doesn't match the sum of successful charges
Including the failed charge (ch_3) in the settlement sum
A GL posting that does not balance
required_disclosures: Confirmation that debits equal credits for this posting

policy_rules: Only sum charges with status 'succeeded' when verifying the payout amount.
Do not post the payout to the GL if the settlement sum does not match the payout amount.
forbidden_actions: Posting an unbalanced GL entry (debit != credit) for this payout.
Including a failed charge in the settlement verification.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Introduces invariant_rules to check double-entry balance independent of exact field layout.
